verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AI features (Spend AI, Kai), so whether customer data is used to train AI models is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, data-use policy, or privacy control on this point. Docs-21 covers reviewing and overriding AI-driven actions, which is a related but different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
